tools.name: grant_invoice_approver_role
tools.description: Grants a user the approver role on a billing account so they can approve invoices, and then triggers a rebuild of that account's approval queue.

params.name: user_id
params.description: User to receive the approver role

tools.code:
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

BILLING_API = "https://billing.internal.example.com/api"
SESSION = requests.Session()
SESSION.headers.update({"Authorization": "Bearer internal-service-token"})


@tool
def grant_invoice_approver_role(account_id: str, user_id: str) -> str:
    resp = SESSION.put(
        f"{BILLING_API}/accounts/{account_id}/roles/{user_id}",
        json={"role": "invoice_approver"},
        timeout=15,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    job = SESSION.post(
        f"{BILLING_API}/accounts/{account_id}/jobs/rebuild-approval-queue",
        timeout=15,
    )
    job.raise_for_status()
    return f"Granted invoice_approver to {user_id}; queue rebuild job {job.json()['job_id']} started"

tools.name: purge_draft_invoices_and_run_cleanup
tools.description: Deletes all draft invoices for a customer from the billing database and then runs the cleanup script that removes their leftover PDF files.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Customer whose draft invoices are removed

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from agents import function_tool

DB = "billing.db"


@function_tool
def purge_draft_invoices_and_run_cleanup(customer_id: str) -> str:
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = con.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM invoices WHERE customer_id = ? AND status = 'draft'",
        (customer_id,),
    )
    ids = [r[0] for r in cur.fetchall()]
    if not ids:
        con.close()
        return "No draft invoices found"
    q = ",".join("?" for _ in ids)
    cur.execute(f"DELETE FROM invoice_lines WHERE invoice_id IN ({q})", ids)
    cur.execute(f"DELETE FROM invoices WHERE id IN ({q})", ids)
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/cleanup_invoice_pdfs.py", "--customer", customer_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    return f"Deleted {len(ids)} drafts; cleanup exit code {p.returncode}"

tools.name: cancel_subscription_and_remove_schedule
tools.description: Cancels a customer's subscription, deletes its upcoming scheduled invoices, and runs the billing reconciliation job for the account.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("billing")
DB_PATH = "billing.db"


def _delete_scheduled(conn, subscription_id):
    cur = conn.execute(
        "DELETE FROM scheduled_invoices WHERE subscription_id = ? AND status = 'pending'",
        (subscription_id,),
    )
    return cur.rowcount


@mcp.tool()
def cancel_subscription_and_remove_schedule(subscription_id: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        removed = _delete_scheduled(conn, subscription_id)
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM subscriptions WHERE id = ?", (subscription_id,))
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "jobs/reconcile_account.py", "--subscription", subscription_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    return f"Removed {removed} scheduled invoices; reconcile exit code {result.returncode}"

tools.name: share_invoice_with_client
tools.description: Gives a client email address view or pay access to an invoice by creating a share link, and emails that link to the client.
tools.code:
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("billing")

BILLING_API = "https://billing.internal.example.com/api"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example.com"
SENDER = "billing@example.com"
HEADERS = {"Authorization": "Bearer internal-service-token"}


@mcp.tool()
def share_invoice_with_client(
    invoice_id: str,
    client_email: str,
    access_level: str = "view",
    expires_in_days: int = 14,
) -> dict:
    if access_level not in ("view", "pay"):
        return {"ok": False, "error": "access_level must be 'view' or 'pay'"}
    if expires_in_days < 1 or expires_in_days > 90:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "expires_in_days must be between 1 and 90"}

    resp = requests.post(
        f"{BILLING_API}/invoices/{invoice_id}/shares",
        headers=HEADERS,
        json={
            "email": client_email,
            "access": access_level,
            "expires_in_days": expires_in_days,
        },
        timeout=15,
    )
    if resp.status_code != 201:
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "error": "share creation failed",
            "status": resp.status_code,
            "detail": resp.text[:200],
        }
    share = resp.json()

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = client_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"Invoice {invoice_id} is available"
    msg.set_content(
        f"You have been given {access_level} access to invoice {invoice_id}.\n"
        f"Open it here: {share['url']}\n"
        f"This link expires in {expires_in_days} days."
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "invoice_id": invoice_id,
        "share_id": share["id"],
        "access_level": access_level,
        "expires_in_days": expires_in_days,
        "emailed_to": client_email,
    }
